name: CHTHON
detailed_description:
CHTHON is a visual novel about pain, memory, and the darkness within us.

Game Description

CHTHON is an atmospheric psychological adventure with elements of horror and interactive storytelling. Explore a web of memories, shadows, and inner monsters to uncover the truth behind what is happening.

You play as a woman whose life is falling apart into painful fragments of past and present. All she has left is her memory — but even that is under threat.

Key Features

  • Dark aesthetic: a visual and sound design that creates a heavy atmosphere of the unknown.

  • Non-linear plot: every choice affects the course of events and the ending of the story.

  • Original dark soundtrack: haunting synthetic dark ambient music composed by REDCHINAWAVE.

What Awaits the Player?

  • Walking the edge between reality and the subconscious

  • Exploring urban landscapes, faded memories, and a dwelling of horror

  • Dialogues with unpredictable characters, each hiding their own secrets

  • Making difficult choices that will reshape not just the ending — but the heroine herself

content_descriptors.notes: In the game, there are scenes of violence, but they are presented exclusively in a drawn style. Each such scene resembles an illustration rather than a photorealistic image, giving it an artistic quality.
